annotations.title: Check: analyse a wallet with a credit

description: Spends ONE paid credit on the networks it paid, with access, the proof of the wallet that paid it (check_payer_proof_required, 401, without it; check_not_found with another wallet's): evmWallet on the EVM networks paid, solanaWallet on Solana if it was paid. Give a wallet for each family the credit paid (check_wallet_missing otherwise) and none for a family it did not (check_family_not_paid). The free screening (OFAC SDN, issuer freeze) and Scorechain read each wallet once, Merkle Science (through Didit) once per network, at most the networks paid plus 2 lookups in all. Returns check with status used, target { wallets { evm, svm }, networks }, seal (the worst network: red, risk found; yellow, medium risk; grey, a paid reading did not come back; green, no risk, Merkle no_data included), result and screening (of the worst network), networks [{ chainId, seal, result { verdict, risk, tools [{ tool, result clear|flagged|unavailable, score 0-100, severity, summary, category, factors, sourceOfFunds, destinationOfFunds, analyzedAt, fromHistory }], details }, screening }] and events (the real steps, with ms). The same credit and the same wallets again answers what is stored, with no provider call; other wallets are check_credit_used (409). Two calls at once run ONE analysis (the other gets check_running, 409). check_unreadable (503): a reading did not answer, the credit is still valid, call again with the same arguments (details.missing names tool:network). check_crystal_report_missing (409): Crystal did not deliver a report after the retry limit, the credit stays paid, and support needs the payment transaction hash. analysis_tool_unavailable (503): a tool is down and the credit was not touched. The credit is per tool (independent review of 18/11/2026): a paid tool that cannot read now (crystal with the payer's KYC no longer approved, a tool Vurto switched off) is NOT spent: the others read, the result shows only them, and the answer carries pendingTools [{ tool, reason kyc_required|switched_off }] and pendingCheckId, a credit of its own for the pending tools bound to the same wallets (keep it like any Check id; call check_analyze with it later). With no paid tool able to read, check_tools_pending (409, details.pending) and nothing is spent. Crystal without a score for the wallet on a network (noScoreCondition: no score, no sanction, no risk category; today Solana) gives its part back: the answer carries returnedCredit { checkId, tools [crystal], networks, reason crystal_no_score }, a FREE paid credit (no wallet bound, use it on another wallet; the same wallet answers the same), at most 1 return per purchase, then it is spent as before; only the analysis answer names checkId, a later read says it came back, not which.

access.description: The proof of the wallet that paid this Check: its Check access from check_access (vca_..., 24 hours) or its purchase proof from check_buy_proof (vcb_..., 10 minutes, the one you hold right after buying). Secret. Sent as the Authorization header, never in the body.

checkId.description: The Check id from check_charge (CHK-...). Keep it private: with the payer's proof (access) it analyses and reads this Check.

evmWallet.description: The EVM wallet to analyse (0x...), when the credit paid an EVM network.

solanaWallet.description: The Solana wallet to analyse (base58, case-sensitive), when the credit paid Solana.

wallet.description: Instead of the two above, for a credit of one family: the wallet, its family read from the address.
